# Comfy HeyGen Video 1.0- Reference to Video

Generate a 5-15 second video with dialogue and sound from a prompt plus up to nine images, three videos and three audio clips using HeyGen Video 1.0, addressed in the prompt as @Image1, @Video1 and @Audio1. One video is output, with the people, products and places you supply driving the shot. Ideal for product demos, UGC-style clips that keep one presenter or product consistent, and placing your product into a scene of your own. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_heygen_video_1_r2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.model.prompt: @Image1 stands at a plain warm grey studio backdrop holding the handbag from @Image2 up beside her chest, the bag turned so its front panel faces the camera. Her right hand grips the top handle at its centre and the handle stays in her grip for the whole shot. She looks straight down the lens and says: "This is the one bag I reach for every day. The leather softens, but the shape never does." The bag keeps the exact colour, proportions, stitching, clasp and handle fittings shown in @Image2. Shot on an ARRI Alexa Mini LF, 50mm T2, locked off on a tripod at eye level, soft key light with a subtle rim, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, no retouching, no beauty filter, no glamour lighting, no added logos, brand names, printed words or badges anywhere in frame apart from the hardware shown in @Image2. Quiet studio room tone, a faint chair creak, and the leather's soft creak as she lifts the bag. No music.
